dataset: keremberke/chest-xray-classification (HF parquet mirror of the Kermany/Mooney 'Chest X-Ray Images (Pneumonia)' dataset): full/test split (N=582) used to fit temperature, full/validation split (N=1165) held out for evaluation. Binary Normal(0)/Pneumonia(1) label used as ground truth for pneumonia-correlated findings only.
notes: Candidates considered (using Normal-vs-Pneumonia labels as a ground-truth proxy for these pneumonia-correlated findings): F_PNEUMONIA_OPACITY, F_CONSOLIDATION, F_INFILTRATION, F_LUNG_OPACITY. Accepted (fitted temperature genuinely improved held-out ECE, see metrics): F_INFILTRATION, F_LUNG_OPACITY. Rejected (reverted to identity — see metrics[node].reason): F_CONSOLIDATION, F_PNEUMONIA_OPACITY. All other labels were never candidates and also default to 1.0 — calibrating them needs per-label ground truth (e.g. full NIH ChestX-ray14), future work (PLAN.md T31).
